title: Samurai removal 3 of 7: the Launch panel, Samurai settings, badges, banners and toasts are gone from the app
summary: Every Samurai screen is removed from the front end; the PR review workflow editor now opens from the PR row's menu, and old saved settings and layouts still load.
lessons_learned: Removal stories delete whole test files; the dev and the reviewer must read every test in a deleted file, because one non-Samurai test (zooming a parked tile unparks it) went with a Samurai-named file and was only caught in review.
